headline: Up Your Arsenal gains native NTSC-U frontend routines
summary: Contributors merged native NTSC-U frontend work covering state updates, timers and dialog dispatch (#1). The progress commit reports 5,677 of 16,222 NTSC-U functions, alongside an unlabeled 8.38% figure. PAL v1.00 remains at 8.72% matched code by size and 5,807 of 16,164 functions.
highlights: The work remains decompilation progress rather than a newly playable feature. Matching means compiled code reproduces the original game's bytes (#1).
